x: The majority are Field Events which once again emphasises the progress we are making in this branch of athletics. C.Collis.

Before the race we knew that Colin Collis and Eric Gebbett had strong claims on the Tommy Lalande Trophy, awarded to the first newcomer to finish and that our team could at least be placed in the Southern Championship, but at the final reckoning we had first and second places in the Lalande Trophy,…

At the end of 5 miles it was obvious that Colin Collis in 12th position was going to put up a fast time. Eric Gebbett held his place as our second man throughout the race although nearly caught by Bob Plummer between 10 and 15 miles.
We finished 4th in the Open team race and 3rd in the Southern Championship. Times: C.

The promoters very sportingly delayed the start to enable MacDonald, who had arrived late, to take part, and we finally got away at 2-45p.m. At the end of the first lap Collin Collis and Eric Gebbett were running with the leading bunch of men, with W.
